note: Live auto-trade. recurring=true → fires every market day (one defined-risk structure/day, idempotent per day). recurring=false → one-shot on armed_date only. Each day: best passing candidate condor > bull put > fly, max loss <= max_loss, no 0DTE, re-priced + drift-guarded, gated by the risk engine (5%/VIX/cash-floor/drawdown), exit 50%/1-DTE. Stop: /autotrade off, or env AUTO_TRADE_KILL=1, or enabled=false. armed_date is ignored while recurring=true.
